description: BFC 100 is announced: undefeated lightweight king Aslan Tamiev will defend his belt against the division's loudest challenger, Jordan 'Showtime' Cross, in the main event.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Twenty-one and oh? Saturday that becomes twenty-one and one.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You talk. I wrestle. We will see who is tired in round three.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Nobody's seen you hit. You haven't been hit. I hit.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then hit me. I will be there, in your face, all night.

action: Lies on his back on the mat, pressing his hips into Aliyev's shoulders in a positional grind.
thought: Every day, the mountain gets heavier.

action: Fires combinations on the heavy bag while a coach calls cadence, each punch crisp and fast.
thought: Finally. The time has come.

action: Wraps his hands slowly, watching the young fighters from the corner with a veteran's eye.
thought: These kids want war. Good.

action: Drills takedown setups against a heavy bag, each shot explosive and sharp.
thought: Raw tools. Gotta use them.

action: Leads a grappling session with two younger fighters, pressing the pace, smothering them in position.
thought: Grind. That's how we climb.

action: Rolls easy on a mat in the corner, a measuring stick watching the contenders.
thought: Been here before. Many times over.

action: Unloads bombs on a heavy bag, the swivel hips and explosiveness of a true banger.
thought: Bomb. Bomb. Keep throwing bombs.

action: Grinds with Tamiev on the mat, wrestling for position, every muscle tense and fighting.
thought: I'm the wrestler. Not him.

description: Cross approaches Tamiev mid-drill as the announcement spreads—their title fight is official for Saturday, the mountain and the showman finally facing their moment.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Mountain. Saturday. Main event. That's MY belt up for grabs.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Not for grabs. It will be with me after.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: That's what every fighter says before they face me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_aliyev
dialogue.line: You're facing a wrestler. Not your usual dinner date.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Rustam, you got choked. Keep watching from the sideline.

dialogue.speaker: hw_walker
dialogue.line: Yo, both of you bring the NOISE on Saturday. That's the deal.

dialogue.speaker: fw_hale
dialogue.line: Respect. Respect to whoever is standing at the end.

dialogue.speaker: lw_torres
dialogue.line: Cross has the speed. Tamiev's got the grind. This is a real fight.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I'm ready. Every training day is the same.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: That's exactly the problem. You've never faced me before.

dialogue.speaker: lw_aliyev
dialogue.line: He's 21-0. What's your record, Jordan? Twenty and two?

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Twenty and two. I lost twice. Learned twice. You're undefeated but green.

dialogue.speaker: fw_karim
dialogue.line: Both of you are hungry. That's what I see.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Hungry doesn't matter. Wrestling matters. Control matters.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: And striking matters when you keep a man off his back.

dialogue.speaker: lw_torres
dialogue.line: Saturday will tell the truth. Always does.

action: Grinds through a takedown drill, rolling from his back with his partner across the mat.
thought: He talks. I work. Saturday decides.

action: Works the heavy bag with crisp combinations, celebrating the title-shot announcement with his team.
thought: My moment finally. Mountain's about to crumble.

action: Watches from the mat, observing the two title contenders with quiet, measured interest.
thought: Both dangerous. Showtime has the speed.

action: Continues his tidy distance drills on the heavy bag, striking with technical precision.
thought: Stay ready. Title contenders are focused.

action: Throws precise teeps and jabs on the heavy bag, working his karate-based distance game.
thought: Puzzles beat power. Distance beats chaos.

action: Walks forward methodically, throwing combinations while a coach calls cadence, unbothered by the main-event drama.
thought: Walk forward. Never stop. One pace.

action: Watches the champion and his challenger from the corner, then mirrors their intensity in his own work.
thought: That's the level. That's where I'm going.

action: Hits the heavy bag with his signature right-hand power, controlled and methodical, aware of the championship tension.
thought: Loud and quiet. Both ways to win.

description: Cross locks eyes with Tamiev as the Saturday announcement spreads—the undefeated Mountain and the Showtime challenger facing their moment at last, the gym electric with what's to come.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Tamiev! You see it? We're on for the strap Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I see it.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You finally got tested, Mountain. The real test starts now.

dialogue.speaker: lw_mori
dialogue.line: Showtime got his moment. The level awaits.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Come Saturday, you will understand why I remain undefeated.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Understand? The whole world's gonna see your weakness — my speed.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Fastest hands in this division. Your wrestling can't answer that.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Speed without patience is reckless. We will see which survives.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_ford
dialogue.line: That's your undefeated champ right there. That's the level.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Your level is broken ground, Mountain. I'm the earthquake.

dialogue.speaker: mw_hcosta
dialogue.line: Tamiev's patient. Cross has the volume. Both dangerous.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You will learn Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I'm gonna teach the whole world.

dialogue.speaker: hw_boateng
dialogue.line: One's loud. One's quiet. Quiet usually wins.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Not this time, Concrete. Not this time.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then we will make history together.

dialogue.speaker: lw_mori
dialogue.line: Two different paths. Same destination Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Yeah, and only one of us walks out champ.

action: Tamiev steps off the mats after finishing heavy-bag work, cooling down as evening light fills the gym.
thought: Twenty-one and zero stays that way Saturday.

action: Cross hits mitts with a partner, snapping crisp combinations as he rides the high of Saturday's confirmation.
thought: Finally my moment. I own this gym.

action: Flynn wraps his hands, watching the Lightweight rivals acknowledge each other across the gym floor with quiet intensity.
thought: Both killers. This one's special.

action: Ferreira finishes a pad session, striking with the relentless elbow-knee combinations that define his game.
thought: The mountain falls to someone. Not tomorrow.

action: Banks shadowboxes off the heavy bag, tracking Tamiev and Cross with hungry eyes.
thought: That's the fight right there, man.

action: Sokolov drills sambo throws on the mat, his focus unshaken by the championship drama around him.
thought: The champion will defend. Always does.

action: Tonga hits the heavy bag with measured, devastating power shots, his eyes flicking toward the title contenders.
thought: Lightweight crown settles. My rise continues.

action: Morozov works a takedown drill with a partner, methodical and immovable as the evening session winds down.
thought: Eyes on Boateng. One step at a time.

description: In the cooling evening, Cross locks eyes with Tamiev—their title shot finally confirmed, the gym quiets to watch the Lightweight rivals acknowledge each other as Saturday looms.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday's here, Mountain. You ready?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Always ready.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Speed you've never seen.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I'll study every second of film.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_banks
dialogue.line: This fight's going to be insane!

dialogue.speaker: lw_ferreira
dialogue.line: The king stays king!

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: No chance. I'm taking that belt.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Not undefeated by accident.

dialogue.speaker: hw_flynn
dialogue.line: Both of you killers. Incredible stuff.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I've got my hands full right now.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: The work matters, not the talk.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I'll back it up in the cage.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_sokolov
dialogue.line: Champion will win.

dialogue.speaker: hw_morozov
dialogue.line: The Mountain stands.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_banks
dialogue.line: Real test right here, Tamiev!

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Every fight's a real test.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Not like Saturday. Nothing like it.

dialogue.speaker: lw_ferreira
dialogue.line: Champion or challenger. One walks different.

dialogue.speaker: mw_tonga
dialogue.line: Someone rises. Someone falls. That's Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Time to work. Let's go.

action: Towels off after heavy-bag work, eyes locked across the gym toward Cross with quiet certainty.
thought: Finally testing myself against real speed.

action: Finishes explosive pad combinations, his partner barely keeping pace with the relentless tempo.
thought: Saturday I end his zero.

action: Wraps loosening as he sits on the bench, watching the Lightweight rivals with seasoned eyes.
thought: This is the fight everyone wanted.

action: Drills angle slips at half-speed, each movement economical and detached from the championship noise.
thought: My counter work is sharper now.

action: Zips his gym bag with deliberate care, his gaze locked on the two Lightweights.
thought: He has the speed to trouble him.

action: Leans against the cage frame, watching the night session wind down with weathered composure.
thought: I've seen every style there is.

action: Submerges into the ice bath with steady breathing, his iron jaw set against the cold.
thought: Iron jaw never breaks under pressure.

action: Paces the mat in slow methodical rhythm, rolling his shoulders as evening light fades.
thought: Pressure, always forward, always relentless.

description: Cross finishes his final combination as Tamiev rises from cooling down—their eyes meet in the electric silence, the undefeated Mountain and Showtime's relentless challenger finally locked in the moment Saturday will settle.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday can't come soon enough for me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I will be waiting.

dialogue.speaker: lw_torres
dialogue.line: This is it. This is the one right here.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Twenty-one and zero means nothing when I bring my heat.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I have faced everyone who climbs the ladder.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You've never faced me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_karim
dialogue.line: Kid's got the hand speed. Mountain's got the weight and wrestling.

dialogue.speaker: coach
dialogue.line: Both camps ready. This one settles everything.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Your undefeated streak ends in my backyard.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: We will see what happens Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_manos
dialogue.line: Respect to both camps. This is real.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: It's my time now. My moment to become champ.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: The belt will know who earned it.

dialogue.speaker: lw_torres
dialogue.line: Gonna be a hell of a night.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: No hell. Just my victory on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Only the cage decides.

dialogue.speaker: coach
dialogue.line: Both of you ready. That's all we know.

action: Grapples his partner in a leg lock scramble, calm and methodical.
thought: He's loose. Good energy here.

action: Fires explosive combinations on the mitts—one-two-three, slip, body kick—pace relentless.
thought: Four days of this, then he falls.

action: Wraps his hands between rounds, eyes drifting toward the two lightweights.
thought: These guys are gonna hurt each other.

action: Drills footwork patterns alone, studying both contenders' rhythms.
thought: Tamiev's steady; Cross lives on impulse.

action: Sits on the bench sipping water, watching with weathered eyes.
thought: Youth always fights like there's tomorrow.

action: Slips angles at half-speed, each movement economical and detached.
thought: Noise. I focus on silence.

action: Drives the heavy bag with controlled power, steady rhythm.
thought: Grind separates men from boys.

action: Shadow-boxes between partners with explosive footwork, feeding off the energy.
thought: This gym is hungry today, man.

description: Cross finishes pad work while Tamiev rises from wrestling rounds; their eyes meet across the gym—three days until the undefeated Mountain defends against Showtime's relentless fire.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Mountain, you looking tired already?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Saving it for Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Keep saving. I'll still be there.

dialogue.speaker: lw_aliyev
dialogue.line: Don't bait him, Cross. He's different.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Different? He's a tank. I'm a cheetah.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Cheetahs get caught.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Not this one.

dialogue.speaker: mw_tonga
dialogue.line: Yo, Cross is sharp today.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Every day, Tonga. Every single day.

dialogue.speaker: coach
dialogue.line: Cross, pads now. Let's move.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Again.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You're gonna beg for the clinch, Tamiev!

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Maybe. But I'll win from there.

dialogue.speaker: fw_marin
dialogue.line: These lightweights, too much mouth.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Marin, you walk walls and lose to footwork.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: He's loose. Good.

action: Tapes his wrists deliberately, watching the mat clock tick toward the next round, face blank and patient.
thought: Four more rounds ahead. Stay steady.

action: Fires rapid combinations on the mitts—one-two-slip-kick—calling out the rhythm, sweat already heavy.
thought: Stamina, speed, never stop moving.

action: Circles the heavy bag at distance, jabbing and sliding angles—economical, testing every inch of range.
thought: Range and precision beat power.

action: Launches a spinning back kick into the bag, plants, resets for a head-high teep—poster moment with every strike.
thought: Make them see my kicks.

action: Feeds his partner jabs then sprawls over an imaginary shot, drilling the counter scramble into muscle memory.
thought: Bait the shot, take back.

action: Pounds the heavy bag in controlled bursts—left kick, right cross, clinch knee—then laughs, shaking his hands loose.
thought: Body's feeling dangerous this morning.

action: Drills jab-cross-jab on the bag with brutal precision, pure power application, each rep a statement.
thought: Building it the right way here.

action: Shadow-boxes between rounds, throwing elbows and bombs at the air, total commitment in every exchange.
thought: Always throwing, always hitting hard.

description: Tamiev rises from his wrestling round as Cross finishes pad work—the undefeated Mountain and Showtime lock eyes across the mat, three days until their Saturday unification.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You're looking slow today, champ. Cottage cheese catching up with you?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I'm on pace. Question is whether you'll still be here at the bell.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Here at the bell? I'll be the only one throwing combinations, rock.

dialogue.speaker: lw_mori
dialogue.line: Both of you should focus. Talking doesn't win fights.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Says the guy nobody's heard of, Mori. Some of us sell fights.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Twenty-one and zero sells itself. No marketing needed.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Twenty-one and zero against who? I'm the real deal here.

dialogue.speaker: mw_adeyemi
dialogue.line: Both of you are killers. Just handle your business Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: That's what I plan to do, Blackout. Hand this guy his first loss.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You won't. But I respect the hunger. It'll make Saturday real.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Real? Brother, I'm bringing the storm. You won't survive it.

dialogue.speaker: coach
dialogue.line: Cross, mouthguard. Next round in two.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Got it. Just putting this guy on notice—his perfect record ends with me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then bring it. I've been waiting for someone real.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Oh, you're about to see real. See you Saturday, Mountain.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Looking forward to it, Showtime.

action: Rises from the wrestling mat, towel around his neck, eyes steady and locked on Cross.
thought: He talks. I wrestle. Saturday decides everything.

action: Drops his hands from the mitts, chest heaving, gaze fixed on Tamiev across the gym.
thought: Three days. I'm taking that zero from him.

action: Plants his feet and fires a sharp teep into the heavy bag, observing the staredown.
thought: That's champion composure right there, undeniable.

action: Walks steady forward into the heavy bag, cold and methodical, locked in his own work.
thought: Noise means nothing. Work on the mat decides.

action: Explosive bursts on the heavy bag in his corner, hands a blur, watching the rivals.
thought: Cross is gonna make him dance hard Saturday.

action: Fires rapid-fire combinations on the mitts with blinding speed, eyes locked on his work.
thought: Focus on your own craft. Let work speak.

action: Stands at the edge of the mat, undefeated and watching both rivals with sharp eyes.
thought: That's the elite tier. That's where I'm headed.

action: Walks steady forward into the heavy bag, cold and methodical, focused purely on pace and pressure.
thought: Stay methodical. Pressure wins rounds, rounds win fights.

description: Tamiev rises from the wrestling round as Cross finishes pad work—undefeated Mountain and hungry Showtime lock eyes across the gym, three days before their unification war.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: What's up, champ? Still unsmiling three days out?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You talk a lot for a challenger.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I back it up. You're getting humbled Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_banks
dialogue.line: Let's go, Cross! Showtime's gonna light him up!

dialogue.speaker: fw_tanaka
dialogue.line: Fight does the talking. Let's see what Saturday brings.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Noise doesn't scare mountains.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Then why you keep staring at me across the gym?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You're next. That's all.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_achebe
dialogue.line: That's how a true champ carries himself.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Three days, Mountain. Your zero ends with Showtime.

dialogue.speaker: mw_khalidov
dialogue.line: Let him talk. Work will answer.

dialogue.speaker: coach
dialogue.line: Alright, reset for round two. Let's go, people.

dialogue.speaker: mw_brenner
dialogue.line: Focus on your own work. That's how you win fights.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_ford
dialogue.line: That's what elite composure looks like right there.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Again. Higher pace. Let's move.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: See you Saturday, champ.

action: Towels off after wrestling, eyes locked steady on Cross across the gym floor.
thought: He wants this. Good. Let him come.

action: Drops his mitts and stares back, chest heaving, refusing to blink first.
thought: Three days. Show him you're different.

action: Pauses his heavy-bag work, watching the tension simmer between the lightweights.
thought: That's the main event right there.

action: Fires rapid combinations on the mitts, stealing a glance at the rivals from the corner.
thought: Respect earned in the ring, not stares.

action: Wraps his knuckles slowly, eyes flicking between Tamiev and Cross with grim appreciation.
thought: Best fight on the card, no question.

action: Bounces lightly on his toes near the heavy bag, grinning at the electric standoff.
thought: This is what we came for, boys.

action: Sits on the bench, cooling down from his own wrestling session, studying Tamiev with dark intent.
thought: He's not the only wrestler here.

action: Practices footwork drills alone, methodical and unbothered, ears open to the gym's hum.
thought: Everyone's watching their fight, not mine.

description: Tamiev rises from wrestling with a stare that doesn't waver; Cross drops his mitts and meets it—three days until they collide, and the gym holds its breath.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You look tired, Tamiev. That wrestling take it out of you?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I'm fresh. You'll know tired on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday you're eating leather, brother. Your record ends with me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_aliyev
dialogue.line: He beats your wrestling first, Cross. I've seen the films.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Not my wrestling. My striking has levels.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Levels? I'm undefeated. What record do you have, Cross?

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I'm the only one hungry enough to take it from you.

dialogue.speaker: coach
dialogue.line: Cross, mitts, two more rounds. Tamiev, roll with Aliyev. Let's go.

dialogue.speaker: lw_mori
dialogue.line: That one goes to the scorecards if Cross survives round two.

dialogue.speaker: lw_walker
dialogue.line: Scorecard? Nah, someone's getting hurt Saturday night.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Not me. I'm finishing him in the second.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tanaka
dialogue.line: Both great fighters. Respect the work.

dialogue.speaker: lw_doyle
dialogue.line: That's championship blood right there. Both of them.

dialogue.speaker: lw_reyes
dialogue.line: Undefeated wrestler versus volume striker. That's the blueprint fight.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Talk is easy. See you Saturday, Cross.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Can't wait, champ. Your belt comes home with me.

action: Towels off from wrestling, stretching his shoulders as Cross locks eyes with him across the gym.
thought: Three days. I do what I always do.

action: Finishes the final combination on the mitts, chest heaving, refusing to look away from the champ.
thought: That mountain comes down Saturday night.

action: Rolls across the wrestling mat, methodical and heavy, shoulders tight from hours of bottom control.
thought: Wrestling beats noise. Always does.

action: Wraps his knuckles slowly, watching the tension between the two lightweights with a knowing smirk.
thought: This kid's got stones, but stones break.

action: Finishes the final round on the heavy bag, sweat streaming, power still crackling in every shot.
thought: Mountain's real. This cross walks uphill.

action: Laughs loudly from his corner, shouting encouragement to his team, thriving in the electric gym energy.
thought: Three days until the rankings reshape.

action: Performs core work on the mat, each rep mechanical and flawless, unmoved by the chaos above.
thought: Two fighters. One goes home sad.

action: Leans against the cage, watching the standoff between Tamiev and Cross, nodding slowly to himself.
thought: Respect the cross. But mountain won't fall.

description: As Tamiev towels off from wrestling, Cross's eyes burn into him from across the mat—three days until the unification war, and the gym's electric with the weight of what's coming.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You ready, Tamiev?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Ready every day. Saturday same.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Tuesday you didn't have everything on the line. This is different.

dialogue.speaker: mw_adeyemi
dialogue.line: Man, you can feel the pressure from here!

dialogue.speaker: lhw_brandt
dialogue.line: Good fight. Good fighters. One goes home sad.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then Saturday I go home happy.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Your perfect record ends, Tamiev. I'm taking that.

dialogue.speaker: coach
dialogue.line: Alright, Tamiev. Let's get you cooled down. Recovery first.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Yeah, go recover. You'll need it!

dialogue.speaker: hw_morozov
dialogue.line: Cross has no wrestling. Tamiev will dominate.

dialogue.speaker: lw_walsh
dialogue.line: Cross is slick on his feet, though. That might matter.

dialogue.speaker: mw_hutchins
dialogue.line: Not against Tamiev's top control. The champ suffocates everyone.

dialogue.speaker: mw_tonga
dialogue.line: That undefeated record is legit. Real thing.

dialogue.speaker: mw_adeyemi
dialogue.line: Three days, baby. Three days and we got clarity.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday, Tamiev! Don't disappoint me now!

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: See you then, Cross.

dialogue.speaker: lw_walsh
dialogue.line: Kid's got fire. Respect that.

dialogue.speaker: coach
dialogue.line: Alright, everyone. Good work today. Same tomorrow.

action: Wraps his towel around his neck, shoulders still shiny with sweat, eyes tracking Cross across the mat.
thought: Three days. He does not blink first.

action: Drops his hands from the mitts, breathing hard, chest heaving, locking eyes with Tamiev across the gym.
thought: He's here. Saturday I take everything.

action: Rolls off the wrestling mat after a hard round, wiping his face, watching the two lightweights in his peripheral.
thought: That tension could crack the canvas.

action: Finishes heavy bag work with a final explosive combination, then turns to see the Tamiev-Cross staredown.
thought: That's how you carry a belt, though.

action: Stretches his hips after pad work, spinning idly on one leg, eyes on the lightweight drama unfolding.
thought: Someone's walking out undefeated gone.

action: Works through his final core set on the mat, methodical and undisturbed, tuning out the gym noise.
thought: Tomorrow we drill sambo throws again.

action: Tapes off his hands slowly, jaw set, watching the two lightweights with a warrior's nod of respect.
thought: Both killers. Saturday will be brutal.

action: Coils up a heavy jump rope, thick neck glistening, studying Cross and Tamiev with a knowing smirk.
thought: The young lion wants the old one's crown.

description: Tamiev rises from the mats, toweling off, and holds Cross's stare across the gym floor—three days until the undefeated champ and the people's flashy challenger collide for the lightweight crown, and the gym's electric with it.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You see me working, Mountain? Three days.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I see you. Always.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: First loss coming. I'm taking that zero off your record.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You will try very hard, Showtime. That is good.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Try? Nah. I'm walking out champ, brother. The people believe it.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: The people do not fight. I do.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Yeah? Your wrestling gonna stop these hands Saturday night?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: My wrestling will do what it always does, Cross. Control.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I've watched every tape. I know every shot you hunt.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then you know what happens when I land.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Not Saturday. I'm faster, smarter, hungrier than you, man.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Speed fades. Power doesn't. See you in the cage.

dialogue.speaker: coach
dialogue.line: Tamiev! Shower. Fifteen minutes. We debrief.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Can't wait, Mountain. Five rounds. You and me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I will be there.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Yeah. You will be.

action: Unwraps his hands slowly after a hard grappling round, eyes fixed on Cross.
thought: Saturday settles everything between us.

action: Finishes a heavy combination with his mitts, breathing hard, staring directly at Tamiev.
thought: Two days until I prove myself.

action: Snaps a hard roundhouse kick against the heavy bag, then pauses to watch the lightweights.
thought: I see the main event heating up.

action: Rolls slowly off the wrestling mat after drilling a counter-takedown, observing without comment.
thought: I can feel it coming now.

action: Coils his jump rope and leans against the wall, thick shoulders relaxed, studying the tension.
thought: Kid's got courage, I respect it.

action: Works through his final core set on the mat, methodical and undisturbed by the gym noise.
thought: Tomorrow I sharpen. Saturday I fight.

action: Holds a heavy bag as his partner drills, occasionally glancing at the lightweight drama.
thought: That's what the belt looks like.

action: Wraps his hands and watches the gym, ready for a hard round of pad work.
thought: I'm watching the best about to collide.

description: Cross finishes heavy pad work and locks eyes with Tamiev across the gym floor. The simmering tension erupts into words — Saturday will come, and both men know exactly who they are.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Two days, Champ. You ready for this?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I've been ready. That's why I'm undefeated.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Undefeated? You haven't faced anyone like me.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_petrovic
dialogue.line: Here we go...

dialogue.speaker: lw_mori
dialogue.line: Both confident. That's good.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I've faced wrestlers, strikers, submissions. Same pattern.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I'm different. I'm faster, slicker, hungry.

dialogue.speaker: fw_chen
dialogue.line: Let him talk. See what happens Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I know exactly what happens Saturday. You on your back.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: My back? I'll be dancing around you the whole time.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_sokolov
dialogue.line: Five rounds is long. Anything can happen.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: He can keep dreaming. I'm taking that belt.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You believe that. That's your strength and your weakness.

dialogue.speaker: hw_bamidele
dialogue.line: Oooh, philosophical now...

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Three weeks I've wanted this. Three weeks!

dialogue.speaker: lw_mori
dialogue.line: The wait ends in two days.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then let's settle it. I'm done talking.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: All talk is over. Saturday's my day.

dialogue.speaker: hw_reyes
dialogue.line: And that's how champions are made.

action: Wraps his hands tightly, methodical and unhurried, eyes locked on the wrestling mats.
thought: Three days. He breaks or I do.

action: Finishes a sharp four-punch combination on the heavy bag, breathing hard, then stares across the gym.
thought: He's gonna feel me Saturday.

action: Walks through a pad round with his coach, staying low, moving forward without pause.
thought: Same grind every day. Stay dangerous.

action: Rolls his shoulders and watches the lightweight tension bubble, then nods at Brandt.
thought: Two nights. Then it's mine.

action: Wraps his hands while checking out Cross's combinations, impressed and calculating.
thought: Fast hands for a lightweight.

action: Coils a jump rope after a steady pad session, gray temple catching the gym light.
thought: Young blood always talks. I remember.

action: Snaps a heavy round-kick against the bag, then pauses to watch the lightweight theater unfold.
thought: One of them falls Saturday.

action: Holds a heavy bag for a partner, solid and unmoved by the surrounding noise and drama.
thought: Show up. Do the work. Live.

description: Cross bangs the heavy bag and locks eyes with Tamiev—three days out, the undefeated champ and the people's draw cutting weight, sharper than ever.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You feel that speed, Tamiev? Saturday's going to be eye-opening.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Speed goes away when you're on your back.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: That's cute. I've never been on my back.

dialogue.speaker: lw_torres
dialogue.line: Yet. That's the word you're missing, kid.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Torres, you weren't even in my rankings five years ago.

dialogue.speaker: lw_torres
dialogue.line: No, but I'm still standing. Remember that Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: lw_mwangi
dialogue.line: Cross, if he catches you with that clinch grip? You're done.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: He's not catching me with anything. I'm too fast.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Fast men break slow. I've seen it before.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Yeah? You've never fought someone like me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I've fought five of you. They all lost.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_doyle
dialogue.line: Mountain always sounds the same. Respect that.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Respect doesn't win rounds. Damage does.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then we'll see whose damage is real.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday. Fifty thousand people watching me end it.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: They'll watch you try. That's all.

action: Wraps his hands methodically at the wall, eyes tracking Cross across the floor.
thought: Three days left. He'll test me.

action: Finishes another set of pad work, breathing hard, sweat dripping, still locked on the champ.
thought: This is my moment. I'm taking him down.

action: Holds a heavy bag steady for a younger fighter, watching the lightweight theater unfold without a word.
thought: Young men burning. I just hold the bag.

action: Drinks water at the edge of the mat, eyes flicking between Cross and the champ.
thought: One day I'll be fighting for gold.

action: Moves through some light wrestling footwork, unmoved by the surrounding intensity.
thought: Kids have fire. I've got scars.

action: Stretches methodically in the corner, long limbs unfolding with his usual quiet grace.
thought: Faith and focus. One step at a time.

action: Rolls his neck and watches the energy in the room, a faint smile crossing his face.
thought: The beast wakes up Saturday.

action: Works a clinch drill with a coach, methodical and heavy, paying little attention to the lightweights.
thought: Two days. Banks will feel the weight.

description: Cross catches Tamiev's eye across the gym floor three days out—the tension snaps taut as both men acknowledge the countdown to Saturday. Manos and Boateng pause their work; the room tilts toward the lightweights.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You keeping track of the days, champ? Getting nervous?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: No. Are you?

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Not a chance. I'm sleeping perfect.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Sleep well. Rest helps.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: That's it? No trash back? That's weak.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: I don't talk. Saturday talks for me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday you're getting tagged. Got it?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You'll try. That's all.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Trying? Man, I'm taking you down.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_manos
dialogue.line: Both of you shut it. Save it for the cage.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Stay out of this, old man.

dialogue.speaker: hw_boateng
dialogue.line: Let them talk. Saturday we'll know who was right.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday. And it won't be close.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You're nervous. I can hear it.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Wrong. I'm hungry.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Good. Come hungry. Come ready.

action: Stands motionless at the center of the mat, wraps still around his wrists, watching Cross across the gym floor.
thought: Three days. Same work, same discipline.

action: Wipes his face with a towel, eyes locked on Tamiev, breathing still elevated from pad work.
thought: I'm the one who changes history.

action: Finishes a clinch drill with his coach, then steps back and observes the lightweight tension without breaking rhythm.
thought: Two men hunting the same crown.

action: Continues light footwork drills, unbothered, occasionally glancing over at the lightweights' silent standoff.
thought: Young men with fire always burn bright.

action: Pauses heavy-bag work and turns to watch the staredown, grinning slightly at the electric charge.
thought: That's the energy I need right there.

action: Winds down from a sparring session, sits at the edge of the mat, tracking Tamiev and Cross.
thought: One of them won't leave the same.

action: Moves through slow stretching in the corner, dark eyes occasionally rising to the gym's center stage.
thought: Pressure breaks everyone, mountain or man.

action: Takes a water break on the bench, watching the two lightweights with the calm of a veteran gatekeeper.
thought: I've seen hungry fighters before.

description: Three days out, Cross steps toward the center as Tamiev watches—the air snaps tight, the room quiets, and the hunt for Saturday's crown begins in earnest.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You feel it yet, champ? The heat coming?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Heat doesn't break stone, Cross. You know that.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Stone cracks. I'm going to crack you.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You will try. Saturday, you will try.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Not try. I'm taking that belt home.

dialogue.speaker: coach
dialogue.line: Alright, that's enough jawing. Save it for the cage.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday can't come fast enough, man.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: It will come. And you will learn.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I've learned plenty. From everyone but you.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then Saturday will be your education.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Bring it, Mountain. I'm done waiting.

dialogue.speaker: hw_muller
dialogue.line: Kid's got fire. Let's see if he's got the hands.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I've got everything, Müller. Just wait.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Hands fade. Discipline remains. We will see.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday, undefeated dies.

dialogue.speaker: lw_novak
dialogue.line: Kid, the hype won't hurt him in the cage.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Neither will his wrestling. Not against me.

action: Stands motionless at the center, wraps loose on his wrists, watching Cross with unblinking intensity.
thought: He came to me. Good.

action: Steps to the center, chest high, eyes locked on Tamiev, breathing still sharp from pad work.
thought: Three days. This is it.

action: Pauses his heavy work and turns to watch the moment, arms at his sides.
thought: The hunger in that kid is real.

action: Moves to the edge of the mat, observing the lightweights with a veteran's calm.
thought: Finally. Testing time is coming.

action: Stops his bag work and watches from his station, noting the shift in energy.
thought: This is the moment right here.

action: Steps closer, drawn to the apex of the division, watching both men with wide eyes.
thought: This is what I'm fighting toward.

action: Wraps his hands slowly, tracking the lightweights while winding down his session.
thought: Elite always shows up like this.

action: Continues his methodical footwork, head still steady, but his eyes drift to the center.
thought: The countdown is real now.

description: Cross moves to the center; Tamiev's standing still, wraps loose at his wrists, watching—the gym falls quiet, and the weight of Saturday suddenly belongs to both men.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You ready for me, Tamiev?

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Always am.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_manos
dialogue.line: Here we go again.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Three days. You're human, Mountain.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_brandt
dialogue.line: Boy's got guts, I'll give him that.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Guts don't win titles, Cross.

dialogue.speaker: lw_balogun
dialogue.line: This is what I'm chasing right here.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I've trained too hard for this. I'm taking it Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: fw_hale
dialogue.line: That's the hunger right there.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Bring it all, Cross. That's what I want.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Oh, you'll get it.

dialogue.speaker: hw_flynn
dialogue.line: These two are on another level, man.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_manos
dialogue.line: Tamiev hasn't been tested yet. Maybe this is it.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Maybe.

dialogue.speaker: mw_brenner
dialogue.line: Three days.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Three days till you learn the difference.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Between what, exactly?

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Between the man and the myth.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_brandt
dialogue.line: He believes it. That's for damn sure.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Saturday will answer everything.

action: Stands motionless at center, wraps loose on his wrists, eyes unblinking and locked on Cross.
thought: Mountain doesn't move. Let him come.

action: Steps forward with chest high, breath sharp from pad work, fists up and loose.
thought: This is my moment. This is it.

action: Pauses his heavy bag work and turns fully to watch, wraps still tight on his wrists.
thought: Here we go. The main event's starting.

action: Stops his sparring rounds and walks to the mat edge, arms folded across his chest.
thought: One walks out champ. One walks out empty.

action: Stops his bag work midway and watches from his station, nodding slow and steady.
thought: These two carry the whole division.

action: Continues his light footwork but his eyes drift to the center, tracking both men.
thought: Tamiev won't be rushed. Cross doesn't know yet.

action: Stands from his pad work, bouncing lightly on his toes, watching the face-off.
thought: The show before the show.

action: Wraps his hands slowly, eyes steady on both men, face unsmiling and still.
thought: Smart range wins this, not explosions.

description: Tamiev and Cross lock eyes at center; Cross calls out the mountain, and the gym holds its breath as Saturday's main event simmers in real time.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday's the night you lose, champ.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: You believe this.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: I know it. Speed, athleticism, I'm different.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Then show me now.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Saturday, all the world watches.

dialogue.speaker: fw_hale
dialogue.line: Save it for the cage, boys.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: He can't stay undefeated forever. That's me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Many have believed. All have failed.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Not like me. I'm the future.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Come, then.

dialogue.speaker: hw_walker
dialogue.line: This is what we came for.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: Your mountain gets moved Saturday night.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: Mountains do not move.

dialogue.speaker: lw_novak
dialogue.line: One will break. Always does.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: It won't be me.

dialogue.speaker: lw_tamiev
dialogue.line: We will learn Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: fw_chen
dialogue.line: The champ's unfazed.

dialogue.speaker: lw_cross
dialogue.line: You should be!

dialogue.speaker: fw_hale
dialogue.line: Alright, let's keep training.

dialogue.speaker: lhw_sokolov
dialogue.line: Cross has fire. Tamiev has time.
